title: Navimower 0.5.0-beta30

## Read-only manufacturer task and start-type diagnostics

- Add `vendor_task_codes` to Home Assistant Download diagnostics, decoding cached official MowerTask `m_task_status` states (including 7 TASK_MOW_BY_USER, 8 TASK_MOW_PLAN_LOOP_WAITING, and 9 TASK_MOW_MANUAL_LOOP_WAITING).
- Expose official MowerWorkInfo `mowStartType` semantics (-1 UNKNOWN, 0 AUTO, 1 USER), keeping separately received MQTT explicit, MQTT packed `mapWorkPosition` word 3, and private-cloud packed word 3 observations with provenance and freshness.
- Include `undrawnPileReason` waiting reason with the vendor's hexadecimal parsing; report `c_plan_status` separately without conflating it with MowerTask day state.
- Return null/unknown when values are absent, invalid, or unsupported. Preserve raw numeric values rather than guessing meanings.
- Maintain legacy `work_mode` diagnostic field for compatibility. The packed third work-position word means mowing start type and is NOT the configurable Work mode / mowing speed.
- All new data derives exclusively from existing cached MQTT and private-cloud `today_plan`, `location`, and `index2` responses. No new network polling, commands, gating, or changes to the control/Smart Resume/Map Card logic.
- Add regression tests for known and unknown values, independent data sources, freshness and read-only behavior.

These codes describe the original mowing task kind or day/loop-wait state, not who most recently pressed Continue in the vendor app. Never treat them as proof of vendor auto-resume attribution.
